**A fast, aesthetic, zero-dependency Go statusline & real-time usage bar for Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`).**

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

--- ## Features - **Zero dependencies, millisecond startup** — Single static Go binary; renders in a few milliseconds without slowing down `agy`. - **4 curated 24-bit TrueColor themes** — `catppuccin` (default), `tokyo-night`, `nord`, and `mono`. - **3 visual styles** — `minimal` (pure Unicode, works out of the box in any terminal), `badge` (universal colored badges, no Nerd Font required), and `pill` (rounded capsules for Nerd Font or iTerm2 built-in Powerline glyphs). - **3 gradient progress bar styles** — `blocks` (`▰▱`), `smooth` (`━╸─`), and `braille` (`⣿⣤⣀`) with semantic color transitions (`green → yellow → peach → red`, plus an automatic `→ /compact` hint at `≥90%`). - **Responsive layout** — Uses `terminal_width` to render 2 spacious lines on wide terminals and automatically collapse to 1 compact line on narrow panes (`<88` columns). - **Rich `agy` telemetry** — Model & effort level, context window usage & token counters (`↑in ↓out`), model quota buckets with reset countdowns, agent state, Git branch/dirty status, active subagents, background tasks, artifacts, and sandbox indicator. --- ## Installation ### Option 1: One-Line Installer (Recommended) Downloads the latest prebuilt binary from GitHub Releases (with SHA-256 verification), configures `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`, and registers the `agy` plugin: ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouyg1992/agybar/main/install.sh | sh ``` Then restart `agy`. ### Option 2: `agy plugin install` + Activate in Chat ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/zhouyg1992/agybar ``` Then open `agy` and say **"enable agybar"** — the bundled skill will build the binary and configure `settings.json` for you. ### Option 3: `go install` / Manual Setup ```bash go install github.com/zhouyg1992/agybar/cmd/agybar@latest ``` Add the `statusLine` block to `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json`: ```json { "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "agybar", "enabled": true, "padding": 0, "stack_with_default": false } } ``` *(If `agybar` is not in your `PATH`, use the full binary path such as `~/.local/bin/agybar`.)* --- ## Customization ### CLI Commands | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `agybar preview` | Preview all themes, high-usage warnings, compact mode, and pill style | | `agybar theme ` | Switch theme: `catppuccin`, `tokyo-night`, `nord`, `mono` | | `agybar style
zh:
**面向 Google Antigravity CLI (`agy`) 的高性能、高颜值、零依赖 Go 实时用量与状态栏插件。**

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

--- ## 核心特性 - **零依赖、毫秒级启动** — 纯 Go 编译的单文件二进制，每次状态刷新仅需几毫秒，绝不卡顿 `agy`。 - **4 套精选 24-bit TrueColor 主题** — `catppuccin`（默认）、`tokyo-night`、`nord`、`mono`。 - **3 种视觉风格** — `minimal`（纯 Unicode，无需特殊字体，任意终端开箱即美）、`badge`（通用纯色徽章，无需 Nerd Font）与 `pill`（圆角胶囊风格，需 Nerd Font 或 iTerm2 内置 Powerline）。 - **3 种渐变进度条** — `blocks`（`▰▱`）、`smooth`（`━╸─`）、`braille`（`⣿⣤⣀`），随占比平滑变色（`绿 → 黄 → 橙 → 红`，超过 `90%` 自动提示 `→ /compact`）。 - **真正的响应式布局** — 读取 `terminal_width`，宽屏优雅展示双行，窄屏（`<88` 列）自动折叠为紧凑单行，不换行炸版。 - **完整 `agy` 遥测指标** — 当前模型与思维档位、上下文窗口占比与 Token 计数（`↑in ↓out`）、各模型配额剩余与重置倒计时、Agent 运行状态、Git 分支与脏标记、子代理数、后台任务数、产物数与沙箱标识。 --- ## 安装方式 ### 方式 1：一行命令安装（推荐） 直接从 GitHub Releases 下载对应平台的预编译二进制（带 SHA-256 校验，无需安装 Go），安全写入 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` 并注册 `agy` 插件： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zhouyg1992/agybar/main/install.sh | sh ``` 安装完成后重启 `agy` 即可生效。 ### 方式 2：`agy plugin install` + 对话内激活 ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/zhouyg1992/agybar ``` 随后打开 `agy` 并说一句 **“启用 agybar”**，内置 Skill 会自动帮你编译并配置好 `settings.json`。 ### 方式 3：`go install` / 手动配置 ```bash go install github.com/zhouyg1992/agybar/cmd/agybar@latest ``` 在 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json` 中加入 `statusLine` 配置： ```json { "statusLine": { "type": "command", "command": "agybar", "enabled": true, "padding": 0, "stack_with_default": false } } ``` *（如果 `agybar` 不在 `PATH` 中，请填写完整路径，例如 `~/.local/bin/agybar`。）* --- ## 个性化配置 ### CLI 子命令 切换主题或风格后**无需重启 `agy`**，下次状态栏刷新即刻生效： | 命令 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | | `agybar preview` | 在终端预览全部主题、高占用告警、窄屏模式与胶囊风格 | | `agybar theme ` | 切换主题：`catppuccin`、`tokyo-night`、`nord`、`mono` | | `agybar style
